newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in lacklustre trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Friday.
"The market was quiet and featureless today on lack of fresh factors. Basically most people have squared or are squaring their positions for the weekend," a local dealer said.
"But some people are waiting for next Monday's issue of the (U.S. December) existing homes sales figures and Tuesday's employment cost index data for fresh clues to market direction," he said.
In day-to-day rates, weekend and Monday/Tuesday were unchanged from Thursday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged at 5-7/16 5-5/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16, nine-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-15/16 55-13/16 percent.
